lyrics:
[Intro: cold piano notes, slow kick, a phone vibrating]

[Chorus: female soul voice, sung, aching]
I got a spare room and a key cut for you
No questions tonight, no "I told you"
Bring the baby, bring a bag, bring nothing at all
There's a light on down the hall
Spare room

[Verse 1: female rap, controlled, direct]
You said you walked into a door. Girl, I know that door.
I know the long sleeves in July and what they're for
I saw you flinch at dinner when he reached across for salt
And the way you said, "I'm sorry," like the weather was your fault
I ain't gonna say his name. I ain't gonna make you choose
Not on the phone, not while he's listening in the next room
I'm just saying where I live. You know the street.
Second floor. I'm up. I got clean sheets.

[Chorus: female soul voice, sung, aching]
I got a spare room and a key cut for you
No questions tonight, no "I told you"
Bring the baby, bring a bag, bring nothing at all
There's a light on down the hall
Spare room

[Verse 2: rap, urgent, strings rising]
They say it takes a few tries. I can wait for all of them.
I'll be the same address in March and then again
I put a number in your shoe. It's a lady, she's a pro.
She'll tell you what to pack and when to go
You are not stupid. You are not weak. You are not what he said.
You're the girl who beat me in the hundred, by a head
You taught my son to read. You held me when my mother passed.
Now let somebody hold you. I'm asking. I'm the last to ask.

[Verse 3: quieter, the beat nearly gone]
Three a.m. A knock. I'm already at the door.
You, the baby and a backpack, shaking, on my floor
I don't say a word. I put the kettle on.
You sleep until it's noon. He calls. Your phone is off.

[Final Chorus: soul voice and choir, major lift]
You got a spare room and a key that's yours
No questions today, just open doors
You brought the baby and a bag, that's all you need
Stay as long as you want with me
Spare room

[Outro: piano, a baby laughing, a lock turning from inside]
